Read checked, not selected, for modes. Confirm detail favorite selected resets; manual TalkBack remains follow-up.

fixes.case: G07-1 live night-mode switch on Schedule, SessionDetail and TrackFilter
fixes.cause: Handled uiMode preserves the activity/Page. Core emits the appearance event before edge-to-edge refresh overwrites status icons; the modal also refreshes its window on configuration change. F1's Page load reapply is not invoked.
fixes.change: One per-Page loaded/unloaded Application appearance subscription; post guarded updateStatusBarStyle('dark') on that native Page so it follows core refresh. Keep F1 Page attributes, white pages and navigation behavior.
fixes.F4: Switch night on and off with each of the three surfaces already open, without navigation/reopening. After settling, inspect full-resolution clock/icons; retain dark readable icons and same PID. Repeat cold dark/light launch and navigation/modal/dialog regressions. XML is not icon-colour evidence.

fixes.case: G05-3 revealed swipe strip at font scale 2.0
fixes.cause: Fixed 96 dp strip and -96 translation cannot accommodate native scaled Favorite text; F2 measured the same 252 px strip at all scales.
fixes.change: Auto-width, minimum-96-dp, padded single-line swipe Button; record positive visible actual width per row on loaded/layoutChanged and translate the open content by it. Preserve A1 visibility, accessibilityHidden, automation ID, label function, handlers/gestures and entire column-1 Button.
fixes.F4: At 1.0/1.3/2.0 reveal fully visible Favorite and Remove rows, also after recycling: inspect text fit/no word break/no gap or overlap. Closed minus settled-open session-<id> XML right-edge displacement is strip width in px; divide by recorded density for dp. Expect 96 dp at 1.0, permit growth at large scale. Closed strips must collapse and stay accessibility-hidden.
